<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

Part of [`evoxc_hf.load`](/api/evoxc-hf/load/)

Also available as `evoxc_hf.LoadedModel`.

A checkpoint's static config and its canonical host parameters.

Plain data — an immutable `typing.NamedTuple` with field access only.
It deliberately carries **no** methods and no `seq_len`: loading a
checkpoint says nothing about how the graph will be specialised or where it
will run, which is `evoxc_hf.forward_fn` / `evoxc_hf.build`'s
business:

```
loaded = evoxc_hf.load_hf("path/to/checkpoint")
fwd    = evoxc_hf.forward_fn(loaded.config, seq_len=8)
exe    = evoxc_hf.build(fwd, loaded.config)
logits = evoxc_hf.run(exe, loaded.params, ids)
```

A tied output head is **not** a separate canonical entry: it aliases
`embed.weight` (`tie_word_embeddings=True`), so the tied tree carries one
key fewer and no duplicated embedding array.

## Attributes

- `config` · `ModelConfig` — the parsed `~evoxc_hf.config.ModelConfig`.

- `params` · `dict[str, np.ndarray]` — the canonical host parameter tree — a flat mapping from the
  canonical name to a `(in_features, out_features)`-oriented
  `np.ndarray`, exactly the `evoxc_hf.param_specs` keys.

- `family` · `str` — the resolved `evoxc_hf` family key (`"llama"` / `"gpt2"`).

- `model_dir` · `Path | None` — the checkpoint directory this model came from, or `None`
  when the params came from somewhere else.
